# Web notes

## Procedure

1. Read the page the user saved, start to finish.
2. Write the notes in the layout of `references/style.md`: a title, five bullets at most, one open question.
3. Copy `assets/notes-template.md` when the user asks for flash cards, and fill it in.
4. Say which sentences of the page each bullet rests on.

## Gotchas

- A page that is mostly navigation has no notes in it: say so and stop.
